title: Explicit handling of a new status
method: Synthetic 1,000-row batch: 80 rows use a newly introduced status, leaving 920 accepted by an old allowlist. The 8% loss measures excluded rows, not invalid business events. A visible quarantine preserves the unresolved population.
alt: Explicit handling of a new status. Accepted known statuses: 920 rows; Unrecognized REVIEW: 80 rows. Illustrative values.
